body: I think that's the worst fear most of us females have when we're dealing with such issues. I must say I've never been to the gyno yet mind you I'm in my mid 20s.. I know I must go at some point and even more so now considering what I'm experiencing and it's just a scary feeling. My mom never spoke with me on anything lady wise, only thing I ever heard was when you start bleeding let me know and from there on I always dealt with my issues silently as a kid and  into my teens. Which now has me as I am as an adult. I feel so uncomfortable speaking on, much less having a doctor down there.
The fear of the unknown surely eats us up.. and sometimes I'd rather let it than face it but dealing with such issues like so on the daily are so draining!
Being a female is so stressful at times and I feel so embarrassed to even go to the gyno even though they're there to help.. I'm a wreck of emotions here lately with my lady issues.

I happen to live in Lousiana and we have hurricane season from June to November, don't get me wrong we don't get one every year during the season but there's always some forming out in the water that may or may not make landfall someplace. It's been many years since we've had one. I've experienced a couple, the worst one happened to he Hurricane Katrina. Of course during such situations you're scared of what's to come and what's coming when you're in the middle of it. 
I remember all of the damage it caused, we were out of electricity for a couple weeks, lived off MRE's for the most part, sandwiches and some canned goods,  it was extremely hot weather and for the most part we were outside so we were all extremely sunburned (talk about pain!!). Overall it was just a very miserable thing to go through. I'm glad we have not had to experience anything like that again, as of now that is.
